unseal.subtitle: The system is encrypted. Please enter the Master Key.

groups.title: Local Groups & Permissions
groups.subtitle: Groups bundle permissions. LDAP users automatically inherit a group's rights when their LDAP group DN is mapped.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.hint: Strings of the form "%{example}". Usable in views/API guards via group_service.user_has_permission(roles, "%{example}").

ldap.title: LDAP Group Mapping
ldap.hint: LDAP group DNs whose members are granted this group on login. e.g. cn=ops,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com

members.title: Members
members.hint: Users explicitly assigned to this group. LDAP users get this group automatically on login via the LDAP mapping.

permissions.intro: Permissions are loaded automatically from active modules and plugins. Group assignments take effect on next login. Direct user grants apply immediately (after re-login).

settings.vault_offline_hint: Changes cannot be saved. Configure providers via environment variables (.env).
settings.chain_hint: On login, providers are tried in this order. "Apply" saves and reloads providers immediately.

ldap.title: LDAP / Active Directory
ldap.missing_fields: URL, Bind DN, and password must be filled.

oidc.title: OIDC / OAuth2 (Authentik, Keycloak, …)
oidc.quickstart_text: In Authentik: Application → Provider → OAuth2/OpenID → enter Redirect URI → copy Client ID / Secret.
